meta.title: Inspectorate 2.0 • Transformation Timeline
meta.subtitle: Source: Excalidraw v2 proposal (updated 18 Oct 2026). Draft; not approved with BV, Avasant or Simon.

notes.Foundation:
Build before Day 1 so M1 starts executing.
Netskope expires Nov-26.
notes.Identity:
Our Entra = master identity. SSO trust to BV
OneLogin, no directory trust. Fallback: two
logins.
notes.Applications:
Hosting + identity only, no redesign. Users
log in with Inspectorate account from any
laptop. Web apps to Entra, Windows/LDAP apps
to our Managed AD.
notes.Devices:
Laptops wiped, rebuilt into our Intune
(Autopilot; BV deregisters first). Phones
re-enrolled. ~5,000 devices, ~60-80/day. BV
account disabled when region done.
notes.Network:
345 sites, 52 shared. ~Half not working
today, some on 4G. Site lever (EUR 6.78M/yr)
only released when a site is fully out.
notes.Finance:
Finance TSA exits all-or-nothing per
country. New SaaS ledger (Fusion lead, D365
challenger). Country goes live with or after
its site exit.
notes.TSA: What we pay BV until each lever is exited.
